units.source_text: “那次战争爆发前，两国当然谁也不敢放松警惕，虎视眈眈地观察彼此，它们互相都有畏惧。

en.t: Before that war broke out, of course neither country dared let down its guard; each watched the other intently, and both were afraid of one another.

units.source_text: 后来，一只居住在河童国的水獭去拜访一对河童夫妇。

en.t: Later, an otter living in the land of the kappa went to visit a kappa couple.

units.source_text: 夫妻中的雄河童丈夫不思进取，雌河童原计划杀了丈夫。

en.t: The male kappa husband in the couple had no ambition, and the female kappa had originally planned to kill him.

units.source_text: 她丈夫还购买了寿险，搞不好在某种程度上这也是她谋杀亲夫的原因呢。”

en.t: Her husband had even bought life insurance, and for all we know, that may also have been part of the reason she murdered him.
